page: Amazon Web Services r8id.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 128 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 6975P-C processors running at 3.9 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 1024.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, yielding 8.0 GB of memory per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 7600 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core CPU performance in stress-ng and Geekbench multi-core tests, alongside top-tier results in Passmark CPU and database operations. The instance also exhibits top-tier memory bandwidth for read-only operations across both small and large blocks. However, single-core CPU performance and Passmark memory scores fall into the average category, highlighting a performance profile optimized for parallelized, multi-threaded execution rather than single-threaded speed.

The inclusion of Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512 instructions supports advanced mathematical operations. This is reflected in top-tier LLM inference prompt processing speeds across small, medium, and large models. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of high-density DDR5 memory, massive local NVMe storage, and dedicated compute resources reduces the need for external storage attachments, making it a consolidated platform for memory-intensive databases, Redis deployments, and large-scale data processing.
